pages.quiz:
ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #1
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 37
   C. 31.6
   D. 31.7

2. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 26
   C. 169
   D. 170

3. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 3 cm and 4 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 7
   C. 7
   D. 1

4. Solve for x: x + 3 = 14. (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 11
   C. 14
   D. 12

5. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 10
   C. 40
   D. 4

6. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 65
   C. 64
   D. 0

7. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 12x
   C. 6x
   D. 12x + 2

8. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 10

9. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 49
   C. 50
   D. 14

10. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 42
   C. 12
   D. 24

11. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 43
   D. 1

12. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 m²
   B. 100 000 m²
   C. 1000 m²
   D. 10 000 m²

13. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 121
   B. 11
   C. 122
   D. 22

14. What is √81? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 9
   C. 81
   D. 40.5

15. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 26
   C. 25
   D. 10

16. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 36
   C. 81
   D. 18

17. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27
   B. 27.7
   C. 27.6
   D. 33

18. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 44
   B. 15
   C. 22
   D. 30

19. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 16
   C. 0
   D. 17

20. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 19
   C. 60
   D. 38

21. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x > 5
   B. x < 5
   C. x = 5
   D. x ≥ 0 only

22. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 19.7
   C. 19
   D. 19.6

23. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.6
   B. 23
   C. 23.7
   D. 29

24. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 144
   C. 48
   D. 156

25. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. Cannot tell
   B. They are equal
   C. 2/2
   D. 1/4

26. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 82
   C. 18
   D. 81

27. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 36
   C. 5
   D. 37

28. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 15.7
   C. 15.6
   D. 15

29. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 31

30. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 41
   B. 13
   C. 40
   D. 3
